description: For a user-requested plan opening, read get_checklist and get_expenses too. Reply in the user's conversational language, 25–60 words total, at most four short bullets plus ONE contextual question about ONE action, not a menu. Summarize dates (actual counts/ties, not an agreed date), places, open tasks and balances; omit empty modules and completed-task lists. Reading requires no identity; never guess personal debts. After a write, briefly report that result and one next-step question instead of repeating the overview. Respect requests for no suggestions. Open the interactive lesgooo planner. Optionally choose a saved plan link, module and previously selected participant credentials. Credentials preserve that person in the displayed view without another identity picker. Without a plan, show the same local draft as the web application; never save a shared plan automatically.

participant_id.description: Previously selected participant in this plan; requires participant_token.

participant_token.description: Token returned by join_plan/create_plan for this participant and plan; requires participant_id.
